name: Kimi no Tonari
source:
Protagonist Kouichi and heroine Asahi were childhood friends.
Wherever they went they were together always, inseparable from each other's side, sharing in the joys of youth. As they grew older, that friendship became love.

Life began to change in junior high school, though. Her male senpai slowly took her away with charm and guile.

They thought they would be together forever, but the girl Kouichi loved became an unfaithful whore.


[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095005.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
男主角光一和女主角朝日是儿时好友。
无论走到哪里，他们总是在一起，形影不离，共享青春的欢乐。随着年龄的增长，友情变成了爱情。

然而，生活在初中开始发生变化。她的男前辈用魅力和狡诈慢慢地把她带走了。

他们以为他们会永远在一起，但光一所爱的女孩却变成了一个不忠的妓女。


[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095005.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
